What the week creates

week-14 — twenty resources, one public IP, and it faces outward only
$ terraform state list
    azurerm_resource_group.lab
    azurerm_virtual_network.lab
    azurerm_subnet.db                                    # the private endpoint
    azurerm_subnet.app                                   # the client
    azurerm_network_security_group.app                   # deny all inbound
    azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association.app
    azurerm_public_ip.nat                                # egress only
    azurerm_nat_gateway.egress
    azurerm_nat_gateway_public_ip_association.egress
    azurerm_subnet_nat_gateway_association.app
    azurerm_private_dns_zone.psql                        # privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com
    azurerm_private_dns_zone_virtual_network_link.psql
    azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server.db                # no administrator_login
    azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server_active_directory_administrator.app
    azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server_database.orders
    azurerm_private_endpoint.db
    azurerm_user_assigned_identity.app                   # the database's only admin
    azurerm_network_interface.app
    azurerm_linux_virtual_machine.app
    tls_private_key.unused                               # Azure demands one; nothing uses it

$ terraform output ha_mode
    "SameZone"

# ZoneRedundant was asked for and REFUSED: southcentralus returns
# MultiAzHaIsOfferRestricted on this subscription. Same price, same
# standby, same failover -- one availability zone instead of two.
